Bill Easley is a fourth generation musician and fashioned a career as a woodwind specialist. He has performed and recorded with a diverse list of artists, from Isaac Hayes to the Duke Ellington Orchestra.
Bill was interviewed via Zoom on November 1, 2021 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
